scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.pm2:start: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only jandastavej-api
scripts.pm2:dev: npm run build:shared && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only jandastavej-api-dev
